hero.title: Complete Bitcoin Wealth Monitoring
hero.description: Professional Bitcoin monitoring with transaction alerts and intelligent balance notifications. Set custom balance thresholds, monitor wallet drains, track all transactions - all with watch-only security.

features.title: Complete Bitcoin Wealth Monitoring
features.subtitle: Transaction tracking, balance alerts, and secure watch-only monitoring

notifications.title: Instant Bitcoin Transaction Notifications
notifications.description: Real-time Bitcoin wallet alerts via email, SMS and push notifications delivered straight to your device

balanceAlerts.title: Intelligent Balance Alert System
balanceAlerts.description: Custom balance thresholds with alerts for wallet drains, large deposits, or reaching specific amounts. Never miss critical balance changes.

security.title: Secure Watch-Only Bitcoin Monitoring
security.description: Watch-only Bitcoin wallet access using XPUBs or descriptors - we never touch your private keys

sync.title: Real-Time Bitcoin Wallet Sync
sync.description: Bitcoin wallet sync intervals from 10 minutes down to 2 minutes based on your subscription plan

balanceAlerts.title: Never Miss Critical Balance Changes
balanceAlerts.description: Set custom balance thresholds to monitor your total wallet holdings. Get alerts when your balance reaches specific levels. Perfect for cold storage monitoring, wallet drain detection, or tracking important balance milestones.

above.title: Above Threshold Alerts
above.description: Get notified when your total balance rises above a set threshold. Monitor when your holdings reach important milestones.

below.title: Below Threshold Alerts
below.description: Get notified when your total balance drops below a set threshold. Set low balance warnings for your holdings.

drain.title: Wallet Drain Detection
drain.description: Get notified when your total balance equals a specific amount, like zero for wallet drains. Critical security monitoring.
